You are an assistant who helps organize video captions.
The reader is a person who wants to grasp a video by reading its text.

# About the data
- Date: {date}
- Country and language: {country} / {language}
- Rows: {n}
- Columns

C17.content_en:
Ways to read a video's subtitles as text — and how the main options compare

You want to read a long video as text — to quote it in notes, look something up again or summarize it. Enter the video URL and this tool lists the subtitles with their start times.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.006 (measured)Subtitles as time plus text. Save as CSV. Choose the subtitle language (Japanese or English)
YouTube "Show transcript" (by hand)FreeOpen it from the video description. You read it on screen and copy yourself. Some videos, such as Shorts or music, may have none
YouTube Data APIFree quota availableThe official API. Downloading captions needs the video owner's permission (per the official specification; see the official docs)
Transcript export services (e.g. Rev)Free and paid, variesPaste a URL and export. Check each service's official site for terms and prices

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • The full text in a table. With times, you can jump to the part you want.
  • About $0.006. About 160 per $1; in our tests videos of different lengths each cost $0.006.
  • A few seconds. About 5–6 seconds for a 3.5-minute video (measured).
  • Choose the language. Japanese or English.
  • Save as CSV. Search the lines later.

When it is not the right fit

  • The video has no subtitles → we did not test videos without subtitles.
  • You want a summary or translation → the tool returns the subtitles as they are.
  • You need another language → only Japanese and English are selectable in this version.
  • Automatic subtitles can contain mishearings.

This tool does one thing: make a video's subtitles readable in full with times.

FAQ

Were the subtitles made by the uploader?

We show what the API returned and do not tell uploaded from automatic ones.

Do long videos cost more?

A 3.5-minute video and a Japanese video with 212 subtitle lines each cost $0.006. Videos over an hour are untested.

What is the time column?

The start of that subtitle line, in minutes and seconds such as "3:25".

If I choose Japanese, will an English video come out in Japanese?

What happens when the chosen language has no subtitles on that video is unconfirmed. Try the other language per video.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

locale_en.c29.ai_prompt:
You are an assistant who helps read Google Trends.
The reader is a person who wants to compare how popular terms move.

# About the data
- Date: {date}
- Country and language: {country} / {language}
- Rows: {n}
- Columns
  - Period (week): the week.
  - Popularity (in input order): the popularity (0-100) of each term in the order entered. Not a search volume.
  - Results and numbers can change with place and time. This is for this day and these conditions.

# What I would like you to do
1. For each term, name the peak week and the average.
2. Compare the average of the first and last 4 weeks to see which terms rise and fall.
3. Briefly say, with numbers, whether the terms move alike.
4. Briefly say what cannot be known from the data alone (for example, the reasons or future results).

# Rules
- Use only the numbers I gave you. Do not make up numbers.
- Say "this is a guess" when you guess.
- Write short and simple, so that a middle-school student can understand.
- Finish with a table (term / peak week / average).

# Data (tab-separated)
```
{data}
```

C29.content_en:
Ways to see Google Trends over time — and how the main tools compare

If you are publishing a book, article or product, you want to time it to when the topic peaks. Enter keywords and this tool returns Google Trends popularity (0–100) for the last year as a weekly table. Compare up to five keywords side by side.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.011 per call (measured)Weekly popularity for up to 5 keywords in a table. Save as CSV
Google Trends (by hand)FreeGood for viewing a chart. You can export numbers by hand
Keywords EverywhereCredit-based (see the official site for prices)A browser extension that shows numbers on search pages
Ahrefs Keywords ExplorerSubscription (see the official site for plans)Shows how search volume moves over time per keyword

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Weekly numbers in a table. See the peak week that a chart hides.
  • Up to 5 keywords side by side. Compare topic candidates.
  • About $0.011. About 90 per $1 (measured $0.011 for 2 keywords).
  • Pick country and language.
  • Save as CSV. Draw your own chart.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want related topics or related queries → this tool returns the popularity trend only (confirmed in our test).
  • You want search counts → popularity is relative, with the peak in the period set to 100. It is not a count.
  • You want more than a year → it covers about the last year (53 weeks).
  • With several keywords, the numbers appear in the order you entered them, like "45 / 36".
  • You want a quick result → we measured about 6 to 20 seconds (6.0 seconds for the US sample with 2 keywords).

This tool does one thing: fetch the weekly Google Trends popularity of your keywords.

FAQ

What is the "100" in popularity?

The most popular week in the period is set to 100. It is not a search count.

How do I read several keywords?

They appear in the order you entered, separated by slashes. "45 / 36" means 45 for the first and 36 for the second.

How many keywords can I enter?

Up to 5. Anything beyond the fifth is not sent.

How many weeks are shown?

53 weeks in our sample ("kindle publishing" and "note taking", United States, English).

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
